summary: Columbus Acquisition Corp, a Cayman-domiciled Nasdaq-listed SPAC, filed an 8-K updating shareholders on its extraordinary general meeting regarding the proposed business combination with WISeSat.Space Corp. The September 10, 2026 meeting was adjourned without a vote; the reconvened meeting is set for September 28, 2026, with an extended redemption deadline of September 24, 2026. Roughly $10.79 per share sits in trust as of September 23, 2026, against a record date of August 17, 2026. Watch redemption levels, quorum and vote outcome, as heavy redemptions could impair deal financing.
